496. /// An overloaded autoderef step, representing a `Deref(Mut)::deref(_mut)`
497. /// call, with the signature `&'a T -> &'a U` or `&'a mut T -> &'a mut U`.
498. /// The target type is `U` in both cases, with the region and mutability
499. /// being those shared by both the receiver and the returned reference.
500. #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
501. pub struct OverloadedDeref(pub Option<Mutability>);

503. #[derive(Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
504. pub enum AutoBorrowMutability {
505.     Mut { allow_two_phase_borrow: AllowTwoPhase },
506.     Not,
507. }
508. 
509. impl AutoBorrowMutability {
510.     /// Creates an `AutoBorrowMutability` from a mutability and allowance of two phase borrows.
511.     ///
512.     /// Note that when `mutbl.is_not()`, `allow_two_phase_borrow` is ignored
513.     pub fn new(mutbl: Mutability, allow_two_phase_borrow: AllowTwoPhase) -> Self {
514.         match mutbl {
515.             Mutability::Not => Self::Not,
516.             Mutability::Mut => Self::Mut { allow_two_phase_borrow },
517.         }
518.     }
519. }
520. 
521. impl From<AutoBorrowMutability> for Mutability {
522.     fn from(m: AutoBorrowMutability) -> Self {
523.         match m {
524.             AutoBorrowMutability::Mut { .. } => Mutability::Mut,
525.             AutoBorrowMutability::Not => Mutability::Not,
526.         }
527.     }
528. }
529.

531. pub enum AutoBorrow {
532.     /// Converts from T to &T.
533.     Ref(AutoBorrowMutability),
534.     /// Converts from T to *T.
535.     RawPtr(Mutability),
536. }

541.             AutoBorrow::Ref(mutbl) => mutbl.into(),

548. pub enum PointerCast {
